Not sure if other International / European states have similar IT-Security standards, but in Germany we have the BSI IT-Grundschutz, which is plugged on top of ISO27001 (and is also considered one of the standards that are replaced by the ISO 27000 family alongside the british one)

What makes the German concept so special is that they provide a catalogue of requirements/requirement blocks.
You first pick those requirements / blocks that fit your IT-System and then perform an audit via ISO27001 and the requirements you picked from the catalogue.

Block 5.21 of that catalogue is about web applications and pretty much is an extended version of the OWASP Top10 / SAN&CWE Top 25.

I'd find it quite interesting to build a mapping for that catalogue in addition to the PCI-DSS.
And maybe someone from elsewhere around the globe could find similar documents produced by their local institutions that look like they could be mapped to ASVS requirements.

Although: I'm not sure if this would be of enough interest to include in the actual ASVS document or if it would be better to suggest a separate document or Wiki page for this (and maybe other local mappings).


You can find the Block for Webapps over here (sorry, but only available in German for now): https://www.bsi.bund.de/SharedDocs/Downloads/DE/BSI/Grundschutz/Download/Vorabversionen/Baustein_Webanwendungen.pdf?__blob=publicationFile&v=1
